id: \bWhat do you say? Lets have a friendly battle.
en: \bWhat do you say? Lets have a friendly battle.
it: \bChe ne dici? Facciamo una lotta amichevole.

id: \bWant to trade it for my Raticate?
en: \bWant to trade it for my Raticate?

id: \bYou want to trade back, do you?
en: \bYou want to trade back, do you?
it: \bVuoi rifare lo scambio al contrario, eh?

id: \bI may have changed its moves some. Do you still want to trade?
en: \bI may have changed its moves some. Do you still want to trade?
it: \bPotrei avergli cambiato qualche mossa. Vuoi ancora fare lo scambio?
\bPer oggi ho finito con gli scambi.

id: \bI may be seasick, but I can still battle.
en: \bI may be seasick, but I can still battle.
it: \bAvrò anche il mal di mare, ma posso ancora lottare.

id: \bJust stay away from the captain's room.
en: \bJust stay away from the captain's room.
it: \bStai lontano dalla cabina del capitano e basta.

id: \rThis trip is exactly what I needed.
en: \rThis trip is exactly what I needed.
it: \rQuesto viaggio è proprio quello che mi serviva.
